description: Monte Carlo simulation of stablecoin reserve portfolios under MiCA Article 36 redemption stress and asset price shocks. 1,000 paths × 90-day horizon. Coverage ratio fan chart (P5–P95), breach probability curve, Article 36 liquid buffer analysis, fire-sale contagion estimate. Complements ART-06 (static attestation) with full stochastic dimension.
deadline_note: MiCA Title III/IV in force June 30 2024 — ART/EMT issuers subject to Article 36 reserve requirements now
scope_statement: Modelling-convention disclosure (RCA02-RESERVE-TAIL-1, 2026-08-30): this simulator is a forward-looking Monte Carlo stress tool. Its over-collateralization buffer (default 2%, policy parameter art36_buffer) and its adverse-tail adequacy test (P5 end-day coverage >= 1.0 + buffer) are DECLARED MODELLING CONVENTIONS of the simulator, not requirements of MiCA Article 36. Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 Article 36(7) requires the reserve at all times to be at least equal in value to the outstanding tokens (100% parity); the Article prescribes neither a percentile adequacy test nor a 2% buffer. No primary-source basis for the 2% figure was retrieved (EBA RTS pages under Article 36 checked 2026-08-30 state no such figure), so the kernel carries 2% as a caller-adjustable modelling default.
